required_behaviors: network read is deny-by-default when host policy is absent
host policy cannot be widened by call arguments
authorization is task-url-method bound, single-use, expiring and budgeted
network read descriptors use network:web_read without write side effects
research and audit workflows declare network:web_read and compiled workflows preserve that requirement
only HTTPS GET/HEAD on port 443 are accepted by the reference transport
embedded credentials and unauthorized query strings are denied
private and reserved IPv4/IPv6 targets are denied
IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are classified by their underlying IPv4 address
DNS answers are checked before a pinned TLS connection
response byte budgets are enforced even when a custom transport ignores them
redirects are exposed as metadata and never silently followed
custom transports cannot substitute or silently follow the authorized URL
response body bytes are content-addressed and included in result/receipt artifacts
physical native-HTTPS smoke produces a chained authorization and fetch receipt
